title: Landowners
description: Partner with Gemcon City Limited on your land through a registered joint-venture agreement with a fixed share of the finished building.

data.headline: Turn your land into a building you share in
data.subheadline: A registered joint-venture agreement, a fixed share of the finished building and updates at every stage.

items.title: A registered agreement
items.text: Your share is written into a registered contract before any work begins.

items.title: No cost to you
items.text: We fund design, approvals and construction. You contribute the land.

items.title: Your title stays safe
items.text: Legal reviews on both sides, and a clear process for handing over your share.

items.title: A design that fits the plot
items.text: Our architects maximise the approved floor area while keeping light and access for the neighbours.

items.title: Visible progress
items.text: Monthly photos and engineer’s notes show exactly how the building is coming along.

items.title: On-time handover
items.text: Your share of apartments or floors is handed over on the agreed date.

data.heading: From first call to your share of the building

steps.title: Share your plot details
steps.text: Tell us the location, size and ownership of the land. Our land team replies within three working days.

steps.title: Site and title review
steps.text: Engineers visit the plot and our legal team reviews the deeds, mutation and tax records.

steps.title: Agree the terms
steps.text: We propose your share of the finished building and the handover schedule, and you take the draft to your own lawyer.

steps.title: Sign and register
steps.text: The joint-venture agreement is signed and registered, and the project is submitted for approval.

steps.title: Build and hand over
steps.text: We build the project, update you monthly and hand over your share on the agreed date.

data.body:
Terms at a glance

Every joint venture is negotiated for the plot, but these principles apply to all of them:

  • The landowner’s share is a fixed number of apartments or floors, named in the agreement.
  • Gemcon City bears the cost of design, approvals, construction and marketing.
  • A handover date is part of the agreement, with compensation for delays within our control.
  • The land is not mortgaged or sold without the landowner’s written consent.

Figures and shares on this page are examples for discussion, not an offer. Final terms are set in the registered agreement.
